name: Bardo
source:
A friendly innkeeper in Ransen who sets his own pace. He enjoys suggestively teasing Konoe, although he does occasionally give good advice. Despite his irresponsible and lax management of his inn, he's confident in his cooking and diligently serves food to his inn's guests.

[Based on [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamento_-BEYOND_THE_VOID-]Wikipedia[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Cheryl.[/spoiler]
translation:
A friendly innkeeper in Ransen who sets his own pace. He enjoys suggestively teasing Konoe, although he does occasionally give good advice. Despite his irresponsible and lax management of his inn, he's confident in his cooking and diligently serves food to his inn's guests.

[Based on [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamento_-BEYOND_THE_VOID-]Wikipedia[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Cheryl.[/spoiler]
